entities.summary: Martin Heydon is an Irish Fine Gael politician who has served as Minister for Agriculture, Food and the Marine since January 2025. He has been a TD for the Kildare South constituency since 2011. He previously served as Minister of State at the Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine from 2020 to 2025 and the Chair of the Fine Gael parliamentary party from 2016 to 2020.
